_meta.note: Holidays are advisory in v1 — they do not auto-fire events. The GM clock widget surfaces them so the GM can lean into them.

holidays.name: Campaign Start
holidays.significance: Day 0 of the campaign clock. The crew arrives on Jakku to hunt the encrypted Imperial Code Cylinder.
holidays.gmHook: Default starting date. Use to anchor all other dates.

holidays.name: Republic Foundation Day ("Fempire Day")
holidays.significance: Outlawed by the Empire. Quiet identifier of Rebel/Republic sympathizers.
holidays.gmHook: Whispers in Maz's Castle remember what was lost. Sympathetic NPCs may signal the date with a coded gesture.

holidays.name: Tarkin Initiative Funding Day (4th Anniv.)
holidays.significance: Four years since the Emperor diverted trillions into black projects.
holidays.gmHook: Varth is highly active around this date, pushing lucrative off-the-books jobs to intercept secret supply lines.

holidays.name: Imperial Mining Edict (4th Anniv.)
holidays.significance: Four years since the Mining Guild was granted total monopoly and legalized slavery in the Outer Rim.
holidays.gmHook: Brutal crackdowns and labor strikes on Bespin and Malpaz. Carbon shipments delayed.

holidays.name: The Biitu Incident (Great Heep)
holidays.significance: End of Q1. Ship fuel and astromech parts quadruple in price overnight.
holidays.gmHook: Varth uses this 'unforeseen Imperial fuel shortage' as the in-fiction pretext to rush the crew to Bespin in Act 2.

holidays.name: Subjugation of Kashyyyk (4th Anniv.)
holidays.significance: Four years since Wookiees were classified non-sentient.
holidays.gmHook: Trandoshan slavers celebrate with heavily armed hunts across the frontier.

holidays.name: Founding of the Justice Action Network (JAN)
holidays.significance: The HoloNet erupts with unauthorized broadcasts of Kamiel declaring war on Imperial infrastructure.
holidays.gmHook: From this date forward, spaceport security is doubled and any explosives the crew uses are immediately blamed on JAN.

holidays.name: Empire Day (4th Anniv.)
holidays.significance: Official birthday of the Galactic Empire.
holidays.gmHook: Forced celebrations, doubled stormtrooper patrols, heavy curfews. Varth expects absolute compliance and silence from the crew.

holidays.name: Separatist Surrender (4th Anniv.)
holidays.significance: Four years since the droid armies shut down.
holidays.gmHook: Black-market scrap prices surge on Jakku; holdout battle droids become dangerously unpredictable.

holidays.name: Ylesian Spice — First Major Shipment
holidays.significance: The Besadii Hutts flood the market with cheap, cult-produced spice.
holidays.gmHook: BEFORE this date: Varga the Hutt is desperate and broke, knowing the shipment is coming. AFTER: he is rabid and violent, his syndicate officially starving.

holidays.name: Boonta Eve + Thall Joben Speeder Race Upset
holidays.significance: Hutt-sponsored night of chaos. Perfect cover for a loud heist — law enforcement looks the other way.
holidays.gmHook: This specific Boonta Eve is more chaotic than usual: Thall Joben pulls a massive upset victory in the Boonta race. By the morning of the 15th, billions are lost, bookies are bankrupt, and the Western Reaches underworld erupts into violent debt-collection.

holidays.name: Life Day
holidays.significance: Wookiee holiday. Celebrating it is a crime against the Empire.
holidays.gmHook: Heartbreaking moment if the crew meets a Wookiee on this day.

holidays.name: Day of the Purge / Order 66 (4th Anniv.)
holidays.significance: Four years to the day since the Jedi were slaughtered. The Dark Side suffocates the Light.
holidays.gmHook: Master Denia (if rescued) is crippled by psychic echoes; Inquisitor activity spikes across the sector.

holidays.name: Fete Weeks
holidays.significance: Galactic core festival weeks. Trade slows; the Outer Rim mostly ignores.
holidays.gmHook: Imperial offices reduce hours. Customs inspectors are sloppy and bribable. A good week to move freight quietly.
